item.title: Court throws out Trump's ten billion dollar defamation lawsuit against Journal
item.description: A federal judge has permanently dismissed Donald Trump's multi-billion-dollar lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal. The magistrate determined the former president could not demonstrate the publication acted with actual malice.

item.title: Binance Refunds 90 Percent Following Massive Crypto Theft
item.description: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance absorbed 90 percent of the financial losses resulting from a major 6.3 billion dollar security breach. Two analytics organizations reported strong intelligence indicating state-sponsored North Korean involvement.

item.title: Hamilton secures maiden pole position for Ferrari at Mexico City GP
item.description: Lewis Hamilton claimed his initial pole with Ferrari during qualifying for the Mexico City Grand Prix. This marks his first pole starting position in over three years.

item.title: Chelsea defeats ten-man Manchester United two-nil at Stamford Bridge
item.description: Manchester United fell two-nil to Chelsea away from home after Lisandro Martinez received a red card. The defeat increases pressure on manager Michael Carrick.

item.title: Brighton defeats Manchester City one-nil to claim third place
item.description: Brighton secured their maiden away league win against Manchester City at the Etihad Stadium. The single-goal victory pushes Brighton into third place and hands City consecutive losses.

item.title: Coventry escapes relegation zone following victory against Sunderland
item.description: Frank Lampard's Coventry City squad climbed out of the bottom three after defeating Sunderland. Sunderland remains at the bottom of the league standings.

item.title: Enciso secures draw for Ipswich against Hull with late goal
item.description: Julio Enciso netted an equalizer for Ipswich during their match against Hull at the MKM Stadium. The encounter concluded in a two-all draw.

item.title: Tottenham defeats ten-man Crystal Palace to extend winning streak
item.description: Crystal Palace fell two-nil to Tottenham after Jean-Philippe Mateta was dismissed early in the match. The outcome places further scrutiny on manager Pierre Sage.

item.title: Evanilson scores consecutively as Bournemouth defeats Leeds
item.description: Striker Evanilson extended his scoring streak to four consecutive Premier League matches. His goal helped Bournemouth secure a home victory over Leeds United at the Vitality Stadium.

item.title: Brentford Defeats Forest 2-0 at Gtech Community Stadium
item.description: Brentford secured a 2-0 victory against Nottingham Forest at home, ending a five-match winless run thanks to a goal from Igor Thiago in the second half.

item.title: Fulham Draws 1-1 with Villa Following Goalkeeper Error
item.description: Fulham earned a 1-1 draw away at Villa Park after Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki made a crucial second-half error, following an earlier goal by Nicolas Jackson.

item.title: খামেনির সামরিক বৈঠকে যুক্তরাষ্ট্র ও ইসরায়েলকে নতুন হামলার হুঁশিয়ারি
item.description: ইরানের শীর্ষ নেতা মোজতবা খামেনি সামরিক কর্মকর্তাদের সঙ্গে প্রথম বৈঠকে যুক্তরাষ্ট্র ও ইসরায়েলকে ইরানে নতুন সামরিক আগ্রাসন থেকে বিরত থাকার কড়া সতর্কবার্তা দিয়েছেন।

item.title: Four Useful and Less-Known Capabilities in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams includes several underappreciated tools designed to simplify daily communication and reduce user stress during virtual collaboration.

item.title: Neighbor Dispute Over Three Dead Falcons May Reach Supreme Court
item.description: A legal battle involving a half-million-dollar claim stemming from the deaths of three falcons during a neighborhood dispute could end up at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Protesters Arrested Outside US Embassy in London Over Ban
item.description: Police detained numerous demonstrators outside the US embassy in London where hundreds gathered to protest the UK government's prohibition of Palestine Action.

item.title: Publisher Fails to Win Legal Claim Against Meta Over 2020 Ban
item.description: A Canadian publisher with millions of followers lost a crucial legal argument regarding Meta's permanent deletion of its Facebook pages and business accounts in 2020.

item.title: Transfer Gossip: Man Utd Makes Inquiry for Ivan Toney
item.description: Manchester United has asked about Ivan Toney, Barcelona is monitoring Chelsea winger Estevao Willian, and Jean-Philippe Mateta may leave Crystal Palace in January.

item.title: Kristen Wiig Puts Los Angeles House Back on Market
item.description: Actor Kristen Wiig has placed her residential property back on the market for $6.3 million. This follows her previous purchase and listing of the same home just four months prior.

item.title: The Purpose Behind Holes in Electrical Plug Prongs
item.description: Many standard electrical prongs feature small openings near the tips. These holes serve a specific engineering function related to secure socket connections.

item.title: Ajay Devgn Petitions Bombay High Court Regarding FDA Notice
item.description: Actor Ajay Devgn filed a legal challenge in the Bombay High Court concerning an FDA notice tied to Vimal Elaichi commercials. Meanwhile, the FDA stated that proceedings involving three actors concluded on October 30 for adjudication.

item.title: Mass Demonstrations Hit Paris Amid Broader European Protests
item.description: Over 320,000 individuals rallied throughout France to protest declining public services and inflation. The demonstrations included localized clashes between police forces and participants.

item.title: Court Document Challenges Trump Administration's Voting Claims
item.description: A new legal submission disputes allegations made by Donald Trump regarding non-citizen voting in California. Data analysts discovered that numerous individuals labeled as potential non-citizens were incorrectly identified.

item.title: Apple CEO Comments on Artificial Intelligence Strategy
item.description: Apple's chief executive addressed the corporation's current standing within the artificial intelligence sector. He emphasized that the firm avoids releasing AI technology without a distinct purpose.

item.title: Shah Rukh Khan Birthday Prompts Light Displays and Projections
item.description: Ahead of his birthday and the release of his upcoming movie 'King', promotional visuals were displayed on a sea bridge. Additionally, projections were set up outside his home, Mannat, as fans shared footage online.

item.title: Cardiff Defeats Ospreys 26-0 in Welsh Rugby Match
item.description: Cardiff secured a 26-0 victory against the winless Ospreys during a United Rugby Championship match at St Helen's. The win elevates Cardiff back into the tournament's upper standings.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit Set for Nov. 4 in Boston
item.description: The TechCrunch Founder Summit takes place on November 4 at the SoWa Power Station in Boston. Attendees can access networking sessions and growth strategies before ticket prices increase.

item.title: Hospital Accepts Blame for 24 Errors Leading to Child's Death
item.description: Eleanor Aldred-Owen passed away following a surgical procedure because medical staff failed to notice an abnormal scan result. The hospital has accepted complete liability for the 24 mistakes that caused the fatality.

item.title: বিনার নতুন গামা রশ্মি কেন্দ্র কৃষিপণ্যের স্থায়িত্ব বাড়াবে
item.description: বিনা নতুন গামা রশ্মি বিকিরণ কেন্দ্র চালু করেছে যা কৃষিপণ্যের সংরক্ষণকাল এক বছর পর্যন্ত বাড়াতে সক্ষম। সংস্থার মতে, এর ফলে প্রতিবছর ৫৬ হাজার ৫০০ টন অপচয় রোধ হবে এবং ৫৩ কোটি ৭০ লাখ টাকা সাশ্রয় হওয়া সম্ভব।

item.title: Adjusting Settings to Improve Your Netflix Streaming Quality
item.description: Users can alter several settings on Netflix to adjust features that do not meet their preferences. These modifications help enhance the overall video streaming experience.

item.title: Court Permits NAACP Lawsuit Against xAI Over Emissions
item.description: A judge has allowed a legal challenge brought by the NAACP against the SpaceX artificial intelligence division to proceed. The complaint alleges that the xAI facility breaches regulations outlined in the Clean Air Act.

item.title: Clashes Erupt Between Demonstrators and Police in Albania
item.description: Intense physical clashes broke out between law enforcement officers and demonstrators in Albania. The unrest involved direct confrontations on the streets.

item.title: Delhi Deploys 4,000 Officers Ahead of INDIA Bloc Protest
item.description: Delhi is preparing for an opposition INDIA bloc demonstration targeting the CEC with an anticipated attendance of one million people. Security measures include the deployment of 4,000 police officers and 200 security cameras.

item.title: UK Court Blocks Plan to Reintroduce Lynx to Northumberland
item.description: British judges dismissed a legal challenge seeking to bring Eurasian lynx back to Kielder Forest after a 1,300-year absence. Conservationists wanted to restore the species for ecosystem health, but Natural England opposed the release under wildlife regulations.

item.title: IOA Sets Athlete and Member Election Dates for November
item.description: The Indian Olympic Association scheduled elections for ten Athletes' Commission members on November 3 and eight SOMs on November 9. The polls are governed by a code of conduct prohibiting candidate criticism and publicity.

item.title: Tottenham Secures Third Consecutive Victory Under De Zerbi
item.description: Tottenham achieved their third straight Premier League win under manager Roberto de Zerbi. Media analysis questions whether the club is finally establishing steady consistency.

item.title: Nigeria Investigates Two Suspected Ebola Infections
item.description: Health officials in northeastern Nigeria are investigating two potential Ebola cases. Both patients have been placed in isolation as authorities conduct lab tests and trace contacts.

item.title: Curated Selection of Disturbing YouTube Videos Shared
item.description: A collection of strange and unsettling YouTube videos has been compiled as a seasonal recommendation. The curated list offers various bizarre clips instead of a single film or album.

item.title: SRFTI Student Protest Over Rustications Enters 34th Day
item.description: The standoff between SRFTI students and administration persists for 34 days following the rustication of six students. Classes and dormitories stay closed as alumni and parents support the ongoing demonstration.

item.title: বিশ্বব্যাংকের কাছ থেকে আর্থিক সংস্কারের জন্য ৪৫ কোটি ডলার ঋণ পাচ্ছে দেশ
item.description: দেশের আর্থিক খাতের সংস্কারের জন্য বিশ্বব্যাংক বাংলাদেশকে ৪৫ কোটি ডলার ঋণ দেবে। চুক্তি অনুযায়ী, ২৫ বছরের মধ্যে ঋণ শোধ করতে হবে এবং এর মধ্যে পাঁচ বছর রেয়াতকাল থাকবে।

item.title: France Sees Hundreds of Thousands Join Cost of Living Protests
item.description: The French interior ministry reported roughly 320,000 participants in nationwide demonstrations regarding living expenses on Saturday, while organizers estimated nearly 500,000. Although mostly peaceful, isolated clashes occurred toward the conclusion of the marches.

item.title: PM Modi Accuses Opposition of Obstruction and Anti-India Actions
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi criticized the political opposition for engaging in obstructionist tactics. He stated that their actions reveal a consistent anti-India pattern.

item.title: Opposition Lawmakers Symbolically 'Impeach' Chief Election Commissioner
item.description: Roughly 250 opposition parliamentarians gathered at the residence of Mallikarjun Kharge to issue a symbolic impeachment against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

item.title: বাবার কান্নায় ভাঙন এইচএসসি পরীক্ষার ফল প্রকাশে
item.description: ১২ আগস্ট ব্যবহারিক পরীক্ষার সময় অসুস্থ হয়ে মারা যাওয়া ছেলের এইচএসসি পরীক্ষার ফলাফল দেখে কান্নায় ভেঙে পড়েন তার বাবা।

item.title: DC and Virginia File Lawsuit Against Trump Triumphal Arch Project
item.description: Washington, D.C. and Virginia have taken legal action to halt the construction of Donald Trump's proposed triumphal arch, citing concerns over traffic and historic preservation.

item.title: Shah Rukh Khan’s Film 'King' Secures Rs 175 Crore Overseas Rights Deal
item.description: The upcoming movie 'King' starring Shah Rukh Khan has broken records by selling its international distribution rights to Phars Films for Rs 175 crore.

item.title: Why your Apple AirPods won't connect to your iPhone and how can you fix it
item.description: As reported by Engadget, When your AirPods refuse to show up on your iPhone, the cause is usually simpler than you'd think. Key points: Apple Air, airpods, iphone, apple.

item.title: Verbruggen Shines as Brighton Secures Victory Over Manchester City
item.description: Goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen delivered a standout performance on Saturday, guiding Brighton to a win against Manchester City with his strong saves.

item.title: Qatar Dismisses Claims Made by Israel Regarding Election Meddling
item.description: Official authorities have formally dismissed accusations from Israel alleging that Qatar interfered in electoral processes.

item.title: In his first visit, BJP’s Bihar in-charge Harish Dwivedi stresses on strengthening the party
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Dwivedi gave guidance on strengthening the organisation through regular meetings and effective public outreach campaigns. Key points: Bihar, Harish Dwivedi, Dwivedi, dwivedi.

item.title: Advocates challenge 1965 union resolution on English in courts
item.description: The Madras High Court Advocates Association has challenged a 1965 Union Cabinet choice to maintain English for the Supreme Court and high courts. An attorney uncovered the decades-old directive in 2025 via RTI requests.

item.title: Northampton defeats Gloucester as Mitchell leaves with injury
item.description: Northampton Saints secured a win against Gloucester thanks to late scores by George Hendy and Rory Hutchison. During the match, Alex Mitchell limped off the pitch due to an injury.

item.title: রাষ্ট্রীয় কাঠামোর মৌলিক পরিবর্তন হয়নি: জেএসডি
item.description: জেএসডি জানিয়েছে, শাসকদের বদল ঘটলেও রাষ্ট্রীয় ক্ষমতার কাঠামোর প্রকৃত রূপান্তর ঘটেনি। জুলাই অভ্যুত্থানের লক্ষ্য ও বিএনপির ৩১ দফার প্রতিশ্রুতি এখনো বাস্তবায়ন করা হচ্ছে না।

item.title: Glasner concerned about job security at Nottingham Forest
item.description: Nottingham Forest boss Oliver Glasner stated he could become the club's fifth managerial dismissal in a little over twelve months if performance fails to pick up. He expressed apprehension regarding his future.

item.title: Ranked-choice voting system in United States elections
item.description: Alaska's ranked-choice voting method may influence an important 2026 election. This comes amid ongoing legal action in the US involving two political candidates sharing the name Dan Sullivan.

item.title: Erdogan calls for halt to Black Sea strikes during talks
item.description: Turkish leader Erdogan met with Zelenskyy in Istanbul, appealing to Moscow and Kyiv to cease attacks in the Black Sea. Both officials expressed support for establishing a fresh grain shipping route.

item.title: Metropolitan police detain 139 demonstrators near US Embassy
item.description: London law enforcement detained 139 individuals outside the American Embassy for backing a prohibited pro-Palestinian organization. Several demonstrators were older adults displaying placards against genocide.

item.title: India revises export duties on diesel, ATF, and petrol
item.description: Authorities have increased the special additional excise duty on diesel and aviation turbine fuel exports. Meanwhile, the levy applied to petrol shipments has been reduced to zero.

item.title: জাহ্নবী কাপুর হ্যালোউইনে শ্রীদেবীর নাগিনা রূপ ধারণ করলেন
item.description: বলিউড অভিনেত্রী জাহ্নবী কাপুর তাঁর প্রয়াত মা ও চিত্রতারকা শ্রীদেবীর বিখ্যাত 'নাগিনা' চলচ্চিত্রের চরিত্রটিকে হ্যালোউইন উৎসবের জন্য বেছে নেন। এই রূপ ধারণ করে তিনি সামাজিক যোগাযোগ মাধ্যমে বেশ আলোচনার সৃষ্টি করেছেন।

item.title: নিলেকানীর নেতৃত্বাধীন পরীক্ষা সংস্কার কমিটির মেয়াদ বাড়াল সরকার
item.description: পরীক্ষা পদ্ধতি সংস্কারের লক্ষ্যে গঠিত নন্দন নিলেকানি নেতৃত্বাধীন কমিটির মেয়াদ আগামী জানুয়ারি মাস পর্যন্ত বৃদ্ধি করেছে কর্তৃপক্ষ। এই প্যানেলটি পরীক্ষা ব্যবস্থার বিভিন্ন দিক নিয়ে কাজ করছে।

item.title: ব্রাহ্মণ ও বণিক সম্প্রদায়কে টানতে অখিলেশের নতুন কৌশল
item.description: উত্তরপ্রদেশের মুখ্যমন্ত্রী ও তাঁর প্রশাসনকে ব্রাহ্মণ এবং ব্যবসায়ী বিরোধী বলে অভিযোগ তুলেছেন অখিলেশ যাদব। এই কৌশলের মাধ্যমে তিনি মূলত ওই দুটি সম্প্রদায়কে নিজেদের রাজনৈতিক পক্ষে টানার চেষ্টা করছেন।
